issue.title: Psalm tries to create cache directory when run with `--no-cache`

repository.name: psalm
repository.description: A PHP static analysis tool for finding errors and security vulnerabilities in PHP applications

issue.body:
I ran into this when running under docker as non-root: `Could not create cache directory: //.cache/psalm/0256f207edf2e8d3d5f36b8d84c501432f54d6f5`

Testing further outside of docker, it looks like Psalm creates the cache directory and a subdirectory, but then doesn't put anything there. These directories shouldn't be created when run with `--no-cache`.

issue.title: Defer cache directory creation until it's needed

repository.description: A PHP static analysis tool for finding errors and security vulnerabilities in PHP applications

issue.body:
Honestly, this is a bit of a hack, as we let `Config` to generate the
cache directory name and then reset it to null from the cli entrypoint.
Yet it's easier than passing a no-cache flag through so many layers of
static calls.

`$this->cache_directory_initialized` flag is used to make sure we
attempt to create the directory only once.

Fixes vimeo/psalm#4267
